title: The execution features Salaam and AgentPod agree on over ACP
description: `_meta["salaam.dev/executionFeatures"]` in ACP `initialize`: AgentPod's client capabilities advertise it and Salaam's answer carries it, additive to `salaam.dev/features`, whose strict receipt contract is unchanged (salaam:src/acp/sessions.ts initialize; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-acp.ts SalaamExecutionFeatures). Closed: a feature neither side names would expand authority.
